name: Munch
summary: Munch uses AI to repurpose video content into multiple short-form clips for social media, with auto captions, highlights, and SEO insights.
description:
Munch uses AI to repurpose video content into multiple short-form clips for social media, with auto captions, highlights, and SEO insights.

Munch studio creates done-for-you social media content that’s on-brand, on-time, and hands-free. Try the AI-powered way today.

AI highlight selection: Analyzes videos and finds the most engaging moments to create viral-ready clips for social media. Auto-captioning: Adds accurate, on-brand subtitles in a variety of styles to increase accessibility and reach. SEO scoring: AI evaluates clip content for shareability and discoverability, helping maximize engagement. Multi-platform export: Easily export content for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more.

howToUse.title: Register for Munch
howToUse.description: Sign up for Munch and log in to your dashboard to start repurposing content.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Source Video
howToUse.description: Click 'Upload' and select the video you want to repurpose. Munch will process most major video formats.

howToUse.title: AI Highlight Detection
howToUse.description: Let Munch's AI automatically analyze your video and select the best moments for short-form, viral-ready clips.

howToUse.title: Edit and Add Captions
howToUse.description: Review the suggested clips, trim as needed, and add or edit captions styled for your brand.

howToUse.title: SEO & Platform Optimization
howToUse.description: Use Munch's SEO tools to optimize each clip for shareability and discoverability on social platforms.

howToUse.title: Export for Multi-Platform Use
howToUse.description: Export your clips in the correct format for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and more. Download or share via direct link.
